about.label: OUR DNA
about.title: Born from Complexity
about.description: FYGroup didn't start in a boardroom; it started in the trenches of mission-critical engineering. We were the team called in when "standard" solutions failed under the pressure of scale.
about.philosophy: Our philosophy is built on technical excellence and the Japanese principle of Omotenashi—anticipating your system's needs before they become constraints. Every line of code is written with the future in mind.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Timelines vary by scope, but a standard SaaS MVP typically spans 12-16 weeks from discovery to initial launch. We prioritize quality over speed to ensure long-term stability.

items.question: Do you offer post-launch support?
items.answer: Yes, we offer flexible maintenance and growth retainers to ensure your platform remains cutting-edge and scales as your user base grows. Our support packages are tailored to your specific needs.

items.question: What is your tech stack?
items.answer: We specialize in modern Vue 3 / Nuxt 3 frontends, with PocketBase and Clojure. We choose the best tools for each specific problem.
